resolved_conditional_facts: CREATE session/rdata/wdata uses _mcalloc -> _mmalloc -> memset0; successful creation gives zero wdata_size/server flag and independently owned FIFO allocations (socket.cpp726-739, malloc.cpp330-335). delete_session frees rdata/wdata/session_data/socket_data then clears slot (741-755). _realloc_fifo and _realloc_writefifo are the inventoried resizing owners, not caller buffer owners.

Active _mrealloc reads its allocator header; shrinking old_size>size returns same allocation without physically shrinking. Otherwise it allocates a new region, copies old_size bytes if nonnull, frees old region, returns new pointer. Equal size also follows allocate/copy/free path. socket records requested logical max_wdata, which may be below retained physical capacity on shrink.

Under coherent live allocator metadata/pool ownership, valid request, defined internal accesses and standard malloc semantics, newly allocated FIFO storage cannot overlap the live automatic caller p or the still-live old FIFO. Only old FIFO is copied/freed; neither &p nor bl is given to allocator. This is conditional configured implementation reasoning, not equality-guard proof.

_mmalloc invalid zero/negative-after-long-conversion request logs and returns nullptr; _mrealloc can then free old region and return nullptr. _mcalloc would memset a nullptr for invalid request. Positive real allocation failures in large/pool paths log fatal then exit. Therefore not all allocation failures leave a valid FIFO or return normally.

No zero allocation is requested by emotion WFIFOHEAD or normal positive reserve. Healthy client bounded queue arithmetic prevents the huge invalid-size range; arbitrary corrupted/maximal size_t state is not covered.
required_invariants: session is a live accepted player slot and wdata is a live unique _mmalloc/_mcalloc allocation with matching metadata; no stale/reused descriptor/slot between checks and copy

allocator pools/free lists/metadata are coherent and initialized; header/checksum typed accesses and alignment have defined behavior under configured GCC ABI/extension contract; no simultaneous corruption or allocator interposition
wdata_size <= max_wdata, bounded additions/round-up/size*4 and metadata allocation sums do not overflow; allocator request is positive and within signed-long representability
recipient helpers, deferred-free path, signals and other reentrancy do not invalidate p, sd, session, old FIFO or allocator state

resolved_conditional_facts: With len7, WFIFOHEAD checks size+7 and expands only when needed. Grow starts16384 and increments16384 until capacity >= size+7. For client entry queue <=1048576 the required pre-copy capacity is at most1064960, so this fixed-length addition/round-up cannot wrap size_t on reviewed64-bit ABI. memcpy then writes exactly bytes [wdata_size,wdata_size+7). This is a conditional local bound, not global queue-invariant proof.

WFIFOSET checks overflow AFTER memcpy. Its overflow diagnostic and exit are not a preventative capacity guarantee. It accesses session[fd] before validating fd; earlier valid/stable fd invariant is needed. Invalid session/null wdata can return0, but this late check cannot make an earlier invalid memcpy defined.

7 is neither0 nor>65535; active socket_max_client_packet65535 also excludes the too-large-client-packet branch for this fixed len. For client pending size+7>1048576 the bytes have already been copied but cursor is NOT committed: ShowError, set_eof, return0. No receipt/queue success inferred.

Normal commit increases wdata_size by7. Conditional non-server invariant excludes immediate flush; reserve16384 can still allocate/fail AFTER cursor advance. Postcommit pending<=1048576 gives required logical capacity<=1064960; shrink quarter condition is safe under explicit sane logical-capacity arithmetic invariant. Allocation fatal exit, not guaranteed normal return, remains possible.
If server flag is not excluded, >=524288 pending data synchronously flushes; subsequent reserve65536 and use of the cached s demand callback/session stability. This branch is not silently deleted.

Source/FIFO disjointness derives conditionally from automatic caller storage vs separately owned configured allocation, NOT WFIFOP==buf guard after realloc. The equality-invalid-source WBUFW(buf,0) diagnostic is unreachable under that disjointness bound; no portable alias/alignment safety for its uint16 load or for every invalid-source branch is claimed.
